reviews.classification: complete dated combat-data/UI or digestion research receipt with separate proof states
reviews.disposition:
All23 receipt lines were reviewed with the combat design's LCT1/LCB1–3 context. Open signed notches, gain/logistic dials,22 pathway leans,12 mapped formula keys/10 null keys, the Sequence9–5 curve and dated subjects are authored model choices, not canon magnitudes or a universal power law. Ten transformed L1 rows and signature clipping are distinct changes. The disclosed extra signature cap enforces the chosen three-hit calibration; it is not established merely by a general firearm comparison. Keep that modeling deviation visible rather than importing the cap into source law, forcing every low-sequence body to equal durability, or requiring every advantage to pay a balancing cost. Higher-grade interactions follow actual supported mechanisms; a curve lookup alone does not prove them.

Fourteen focused checks and the pre-commit4922-pass/five-fail run have different scopes. The corrected Math.random counter rerun does not erase the failed full run or prove the four other cases unrelated on a clean baseline. No later full clean rerun, native fight, persistence or observer-safe UI is supplied by this receipt. Hook declarations are not implemented fate effects. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), AD38/AD49/AD36/AD43 and actual source/consumer owners govern further work. No numerical row, test, ability source, book passage, runtime or browser was newly inspected or changed here.

reviews.classification: complete dated combat-data/UI or digestion research receipt with separate proof states
reviews.disposition:
All25 receipt lines were read. The named seeded desktop fixture, actual card/fallback interactions and source-focused46 tests support a presentation/focus slice, not an HP/injury repair or natural earned fight. Preserve the minified versus harness-unminified build identities and the earlier fuller fallback build versus later narrow retest. Forced no-card and hostile-goals variants are fixtures; successful withdrawal, failed withdrawal and refused Yield have different evidence. The final card21px ended state, opponent-only waiting and live stale-command race remain explicitly unexercised. Transient aim reset after reload is distinct from persisted fight state, and held-away minutes were excluded by design.

Removing a misleading safety label does not change the underlying risk/policy; actual same-action focus, visible in-scroll outcome and disappearing-control status are the useful UI consumer. Current [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md), [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), AD36/AD43 and optional human review govern current claims. The then-visible HP mismatch belongs to L2b at its recorded inputs, not a newly reproduced current defect. Historical weekly allowance, source custody, uncommitted/uninstalled status and coordinator gate are not current verified states. No image, JSON, source, gameplay, app, test/build/browser or personal save was reopened. L2a here is the October31 UI lane, distinct from the November3 L2 digestion research receipt.

reviews.classification: complete dated combat-data/UI or digestion research receipt with separate proof states
reviews.disposition:
All27 research receipt lines were read with the digestion note's F3/F4 tail. The104856-paragraph official-edition corpus,531 keyword hits and about50 contextual passages are search/sample scope, not full acting-principle or whole-book reading. Missing non-keyword role passages, Chinese/Old-TL/side-story/COI sources, differently numbered locators, higher-sequence rituals and independent second-reader review remain exact source gaps. Text labels, testimony, inference and authored residual risk must stay distinct; a proposed low residual risk for an unshown lower-sequence case is not a demonstrated canon value. The feedback passages conflict as recorded rather than proving a universal audience rule.

The original round's O1 no-digestion-consumer statement is stale. B470 read the current120-line pathway factory: pathwayFacts derives digested from acting>=row.digest; assessment and promotion requirements consume it, and current examination completion also checks the row's digestion fact. This is inspected source evidence, not proof of a played sequence, complete per-pathway acting model or risk/timing fidelity. The note's scalar quality, slow route, exam knowledge and outside-assessor proposals remain unimplemented by this reconciliation; current absence elsewhere was not rescanned. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [world-pass rules](../../../WORLD_PASS_RULES.md), AD49/AD36/AD43 and existing source-locator owners govern selection. No primary text, private corpus, combat data, test/build/browser or saved life was opened or altered.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B470: O1 source consumer correction
folds.body: The L1, LCB1–LCB3, L2a UI and L2 digestion receipts were read completely in B470. O1's original claim “the probe found no digestion consumer” is superseded by L2's later source finding and the inspected current pathway factory. The120-line source input SHA256 is5561a56411b19cc3fb02cc04eda235d6bdaf4a18d633131fa28974f5347efa48: pathwayFacts creates the count threshold, assessment/promotion require it, and the current exam completion reads it. This corrects a source-existence claim, not an executable journey, source-book authentication or a fresh passing test. Original wording is retained here and in the amendment record. The useful remaining questions concern digestion model fidelity, supported principles, time/risk/assessment and exact consumer evidence. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), AD32/AD49/AD36/AD43 govern priorities; the old L1/L2 ranked assignments are not a new dispatch. No primary chapter, private pack, runtime mutation or gameplay check was performed.
